entities.name: Giovanni Malagò
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Giovanni Malagò is an Italian businessman, sports executive, and former futsal player. He is the former president of the Italian National Olympic Committee (CONI). Since 1 January 2019, he is a member of the International Olympic Committee.
